name: Canvas Pattern Blocks
description: exposes Drupal Canvas patterns as placeable blocks.
project_description:
Exposes a Drupal Canvas pattern as blocks that render a configurable pattern. This allows placing the pattern via a block, so that it can be centrally managed.

 Why 
 Placing a pattern through the Canvas UI forks it: the component tree is copied into the page. By placing a pattern via the block, it stays centrally managed via the block.

 Features 
 
 A lightweight canvas_pattern_block config entity. Select the pattern to be exposed by a block. 
 Each entity is exposed as a block that editors place via Canvas 
 
 Usage 
 
 Create one or more patterns in Drupal canvas 
 Add a new Pattern block under Admin >> Structure >> Pattern blocks and select your pattern 
 Place the block, e.g. via Drupal canvas.
